title: Monster eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- monster body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="32" ry="34" fill="#5ee86b"/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="50" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#8cf593"/>
  <!-- left horn -->
  <polygon points="30,28 24,8 38,24" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <!-- right horn -->
  <polygon points="70,28 76,8 62,24" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="48" r="8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="48" r="8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="49" r="4" fill="#2b2b6e"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="49" r="4" fill="#2b2b6e"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#b3f7ff"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#b3f7ff"/>
  <!-- mouth open wide -->
  <path d="M32 66 Q50 88 68 66 Q50 72 32 66 Z" fill="#8a1fa8"/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#ff7fb2"/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <polygon points="38,66 42,72 46,66" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <polygon points="54,66 58,72 62,66" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <path d="M22 62 Q12 58 14 48" stroke="#5ee86b" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M78 62 Q88 58 86 48" stroke="#5ee86b" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cookie in right hand -->
  <circle cx="86" cy="44" r="9" fill="#f0b45a"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="41" r="1.7" fill="#7a3f12"/>
  <circle cx="89" cy="42" r="1.7" fill="#7a3f12"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="47" r="1.7" fill="#7a3f12"/>
  <!-- bite out of cookie -->
  <circle cx="92" cy="49" r="4" fill="#5ee86b"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="92" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#3cb84a"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="92" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#3cb84a"/>
  <!-- crumbs -->
  <circle cx="74" cy="82" r="2" fill="#f0b45a"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="88" r="1.5" fill="#f0b45a"/>
</svg>
